labels.text: Most outstanding derivative positions are transacted over-the-counter and therefore valued using internally
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: developed valuation models. For commercial andnon-commercial counterparties where IDA has a net exposure (net
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: receivable position), IDA calculates a Credit Valuation Adjustment (CVA) to reflect credit risk. For net derivative
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: positions with commercial and non-commercial counterparties where IDA is in a net payable position, IDA
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: calculates aDebitValuationAdjustment (DVA) to reflect its own creditrisk.
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: spread and, where applicable, proxy CDS spreads. IDA does not currently hedge this exposure. The DVA
